newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria shares end one pct up, lifted by VA Tech.
newsitem.headline: Austria shares end one pct up, lifted by VA Tech.

text.p: Austrian shares advanced 1.1 percent on Friday, ending the week on a strong note amid resurgent demand from domestic and foreign investors.
The ATX index of 21 blue-chip shares closed 11.89 points up at 1,097.68 and traders said the market looked poised for a rally towards 1,120-1,140 points next week.
"The air is good up here. It could go higher," said a trader.
Overall 16 shares closed up, two unchanged and three down. December ATX futures stood 12.5 points up at 1,099.7.
"There was genuine buying interest. The market has done an about-face since the start of the week," said a second trader.
Leading the way was engineering group VA Technologie AG, which repeated its forecast for strong growth this year and reported a rise in its order backlog in the third quarter.
VA Tech surged 4.28 percent, or 69.9 schillings, to a fresh year-high of 1,703.
It also topped ATX turnover with 51,381 lots.
"Perhaps VA Tech's gains were a little overdone," said a dealer.
Brewer Brau Union was the biggest decliner, slipping 0.32 percent, or two schillings to 620 schillings. -- Vienna Newsroom, 43-1-53112-258
